newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-HEADLEY AND SMITH CALLED INTO TEST SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HEADLEY AND SMITH CALLED INTO TEST SQUAD.

text.p: England selectors on Sunday called up seamers Dean Headley and Mike Smith in a squad of 14 for the third test against Australia starting at Old Trafford on Thursday.
Left-arm spinner Phil Tufnell is also included along with the 11 who played in the first two tests. England lead the six-match series 1-0.
Fast bowler Devon Malcolm is nursing a bruised foot but is expected to be fit by Thursday.

Squad: Mike Atherton (captain), Mark Butcher, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Mark Ealham, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andrew Caddick, Devon Malcolm, Phil Tufnell, Dean Headley, Mike Smith.
